answer: By employing a staking mechanism akin to a reef, each AI agent must commit a shared resource—similar to shale—into a communal pool. This commitment functions as a financial stake, deterring potential attackers as the loss would be proportional to their investment. An attacker attempting to create multiple identities (Sybils) would need to stake multiple shares, incurring a spiraling cost that escalates with each new identity, thereby effectively resisting Sybil attacks.
